ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 8% high-intensity (white/grey) to 92% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region (centroid) with concentrated high-contrast mottling at the extreme lateral tips and sporadic high-intensity stippling on the mid-right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 38 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased amplitude (5-10 pixels) on the distal sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves originating from the median notch, increasing in curvature towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, high-spatial-frequency pixel patterns (barnacles) at the far lateral margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, faint, white linear pixel sequences (rake marks) observed on the right lobe surface, oriented roughly horizontally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (barnacle load) on both tips; irregular trailing edge margins indicating prior physical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white leading edge patch on the right lobe tip, contrasting sharply with the primary dark pigmentation.
